story.text: 이른 아침 해운대 백사장, 파도 소리만 낮게 깔린 시간이다. 그날 공항에서 우연히 마주쳤던 게 벌써 몇 달 전 일이 됐다.
story.reading: i-reun a-chim hae-un-dae baek-sa-jang, pa-do so-ri-man naj-ge kkal-lin si-gan-i-da. geu-nal gong-hang-e-seo u-yeon-hi ma-ju-chyeot-deon ge beol-sseo myeot dal jeon il-i dwaet-da.
story.en: Early morning at Haeundae's sandy beach, only the low sound of waves fills the air. That day we ran into each other by chance at the airport already feels like months ago.

story.text: "아직도 니 손 잡을 때마다 살짝 '설렌다'. 사귄 지가 언젠데 아직도 이라노, 내가."
story.reading: a-jik-do ni son jab-eul ttae-ma-da sal-jjak seol-len-da. sa-gwin ji-ga eon-jen-de a-jik-do i-ra-no, nae-ga.
story.en: "My heart still flutters a little every time I hold your hand. We've been together for a while now, why am I still like this."

story.text: 손을 맞잡고 걷는 게 이제는 제법 '익숙해졌는데도', 그의 귀는 여전히 붉어질 때가 많다.
story.reading: son-eul maj-jap-go geot-neun ge i-je-neun je-beop ik-suk-hae-jyeot-neun-de-do, geu-ui gwi-neun yeo-jeon-hi bulg-eo-jil ttae-ga man-ta.
story.en: Even though walking hand in hand has become fairly natural by now, his ears still turn red more often than not.

story.text: "니 춥나? 이거 걸치라." 겉옷을 벗어 어깨에 걸쳐주는 손길이 제법 '다정하다'. "…아니, 딱히 다정하게 굴려던 건 아이고, 그냥."
story.reading: ni chup-na? i-geo geol-chi-ra. geot-ot-eul beos-eo eo-kkae-e geol-chyeo-ju-neun son-gil-i je-beop da-jeong-ha-da. …a-ni, ttak-hi da-jeong-ha-ge gul-lyeo-deon geon a-i-go, geu-nyang.
story.en: "Are you cold? Here, put this on." He takes off his jacket and drapes it over my shoulders, the gesture quite affectionate. "…No, I wasn't specifically trying to be sweet about it, just."

story.text: "장난은 여전히 칠 거다, 걱정 마라. 그건 못 고친다 내가. 그래도 이런 것도 좀 챙겨줄 줄 안다, 요즘은."
story.reading: jang-nan-eun yeo-jeon-hi chil geo-da, geok-jeong ma-ra. geu-geon mot go-chin-da nae-ga. geu-rae-do i-reon geot-do jom chaeng-gyeo-jul jul an-da, yo-jeum-eun.
story.en: "I'll still tease you plenty, don't worry. Can't fix that about myself. But these days I've also learned to take care of you like this a bit."

story.text: "비행기 좋아하는 마음도, 니 좋아하는 마음도 다 '변함없다', 내는. 그건 하나는 확실하게 약속한다."
story.reading: bi-haeng-gi jo-a-ha-neun ma-eum-do, ni jo-a-ha-neun ma-eum-do da byeon-ham-eop-da, nae-neun. geu-geon ha-na-neun hwak-sil-ha-ge yak-sok-han-da.
story.en: "How I feel about planes, how I feel about you — both are unchanging for me. That much, at least, I can promise for certain."

story.text: '나란히' 앉아 떠오르는 해를 바라보는 이 순간이, 예전 그 어떤 장난보다도 편안하다.
story.reading: na-ran-hi anj-a tteo-o-reu-neun hae-reul ba-ra-bo-neun i sun-gan-i, ye-jeon geu eo-tteon jang-nan-bo-da-do pyeon-an-ha-da.
story.en: Sitting side by side, watching the sun rise, this moment feels more at ease than any joke he's ever thrown my way.

story.text: "단어는 다 챙겼제? 마지막으로 대화 상황 문제도 있으니까 끝까지 잘 풀어봐라. 고생했다, 진짜."
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da chaeng-gyeot-je? ma-ji-mak-eu-ro dae-hwa sang-hwang mun-je-do it-eu-ni-kka kkeut-kka-ji jal pul-eo-bwa-ra. go-saeng-haet-da, jin-jja.
story.en: "Got all the words down? There's a final conversation question too, so finish it up well. You did great, seriously."

words.example_en: My heart flutters every time I see him.

words.meaning: To become used to, grow accustomed
words.example_en: I've grown used to his dialect by now.
He always takes care of me so warmly.

words.example: 몇 년이 지나도 그의 마음은 변함없다.
words.example_reading: myeot nyeon-i ji-na-do geu-ui ma-eum-eun byeon-ham-eop-da
words.example_en: Even after years, his feelings remain unchanging.
We sat side by side and watched the sea.

sentences.ko: 오랜 시간이 지나도 그를 볼 때마다 설렌다.
sentences.reading: o-raen si-gan-i ji-na-do geu-reul bol ttae-ma-da seol-len-da
sentences.en: Even after a long time, my heart flutters every time I see him.
I've grown used to his teasing way of talking by now.

sentences.ko: 그는 겉으로는 무뚝뚝해도 속은 다정한 사람이다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun geot-eu-ro-neun mu-ttuk-ttuk-hae-do sok-eun da-jeong-han sa-ram-i-da
sentences.en: He may seem blunt on the outside, but he's affectionate underneath.
His feelings have been unchanging from the start until now.

sentences.ko: 우리는 해가 뜨는 걸 나란히 앉아 지켜봤다.
sentences.reading: u-ri-neun hae-ga tteu-neun geol na-ran-hi anj-a ji-kyeo-bwat-da
sentences.en: We sat side by side and watched the sun rise.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 생각해보면 그날 공항에서 안 마주쳤으면 우리 어떻게 됐을까?
turns.reading: saeng-gak-hae-bo-myeon geu-nal gong-hang-e-seo an ma-ju-chyeot-eu-myeon u-ri eo-tteo-ke dwaet-eul-kka?
turns.en: If we hadn't run into each other at the airport that day, thinking about it, what would've happened to us?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 몰라, 근데 어차피 마주쳤을 거다. 이게 인연이면 어떻게든 됐겠지.
turns.reading: mol-la, geun-de eo-cha-pi ma-ju-chyeot-eul geo-da. i-ge in-yeon-i-myeon eo-tteo-ke-deun dwaet-get-ji.
turns.en: I don't know, but we probably would've run into each other anyway. If it's fate, it would've worked out somehow.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You ran over back then without even changing out of your uniform.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그거는… 그만 좀 놀려라. 벌써 몇 달째 우려먹노, 그 얘기.
turns.reading: geu-geo-neun… geu-man jom nol-lyeo-ra. beol-sseo myeot dal-jjae u-ryeo-meok-no, geu yae-gi.
turns.en: That's… okay, quit teasing me about it already. You've been milking that story for months now.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 두 사람이 이야기하고 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What are the two talking about in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 처음 공항에서 우연히 마주쳤던 순간을 추억하며 이야기하고 있다
options: 처음 공항에서 우연히 마주쳤던 순간을 추억하며 이야기하고 있다
공항에 다시 갈 계획을 세우고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 두 사람은 이 관계가 시작된 공항에서의 첫 만남을 추억하며 다정하게 이야기를 나누고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이래 나란히 앉아 있으니까 좋다, 그냥.
turns.reading: i-rae na-ran-hi anj-a it-eu-ni-kka jo-ta, geu-nyang.
turns.en: Just sitting here side by side like this, it's nice.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Where'd your playful side go? You're being extra gentle today.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 장난은 이따 실컷 칠 거니까 걱정 마라. 지금은 그냥 이 순간이 좋아서 그렇다.
turns.reading: jang-nan-eun i-tta sil-keot chil geo-ni-kka geok-jeong ma-ra. ji-geum-eun geu-nyang i sun-gan-i jo-a-seo geu-ro-ta.
turns.en: I'll tease you plenty later, don't worry. Right now I just like this moment, that's all.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You're pretty good at saying stuff like that too, huh.

dialogues.question: 이 대화가 보여주는 두 사람의 관계는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does this conversation show about their relationship?
dialogues.correct_answer: 장난기는 여전하지만 편안하고 다정해진 연인 사이
options: 장난기는 여전하지만 편안하고 다정해진 연인 사이
아직 서로의 마음을 확인하지 못한 사이
dialogues.explanation: 선우 특유의 장난기는 여전하지만, 예전보다 훨씬 편안하고 다정해진 두 사람의 관계를 보여줍니다.
